name: 33917 · N Ft Myers, FL
findings: ZIP 33917 (N Ft Myers) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (52% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33917 (N Ft Myers) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
